caribbean.headline: Antigua Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Antigua is experiencing 88% rain probability, with maximum sustained winds of 13 kt and wave heights up to 3.7 ft. I note that the dominant swell comes from the east with a 7 second period and that St. Maarten reports 21 kt winds but lower rainfall.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Ports Brace for Moderate Winds
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing 24 kt winds and 5.6 ft waves, with a dominant NE swell period of 6 s and less than 10% rain probability. Marseille sees 18 kt winds and lower wave activity.
